ufs_qcom_power_up_sequence(). Currently
column2: it is being updated every time the

column1: agreed gear changes. Due to this
column2: if the gear got downscaled before suspend

column1: (runtime/system)
column3: the PHY settings for the lower gear

column1: will be applied first and later when scaling to max gear with REINIT
PHY settings for the max gear will be applied.
This adds a latency while resuming and also really not needed as the PHY
gear settings are backwards compatible i.e.
column2: we can continue using the PHY

column1: settings for max gear with lower gear speed.

greater than the current one. This guarantees that the PHY settings will be
